operations.name: read_bar0_offset
operations.desc: Read 32-bit value from BAR0 at specified offset
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [esp+4]
mov edx, [esp+8]
mov eax, [edx+eax]
ret

operations.name: write_bar0_offset
operations.desc: Write 32-bit value to BAR0 at specified offset
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [esp+4]
mov edx, [esp+8]
mov ecx, [esp+12]
mov [edx+eax], ecx
ret

operations.name: read_bar0_dword
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [esp+4]
mov eax, [eax]
ret

operations.name: read_pci_config
operations.desc: Read PCI configuration space via I/O ports (CF8/CFC)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x80000000
or eax, [esp+4]
mov edx, 0xcf8
out dx, eax
mov edx, 0xcfc
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: probe_bar0_size
operations.desc: Probe BAR0 size by writing/reading size detection pattern
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov edx, [esp+4]
mov eax, 0xffffffff
mov [edx], eax
mov eax, [edx]
not eax
add eax, 1
ret

operations.name: detect_interrupt_line
operations.desc: Read interrupt line from PCI configuration space
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x8000003c
mov edx, 0xcf8
out dx, eax
mov edx, 0xcfc
in eax, dx
and eax, 0xff
ret
